item.text: Thank you so much for taking care of the plants while I was away. The basil looks even healthier than when I left, and I really appreciate the attention you gave it. I’m also grateful that you noticed the window was leaking and let me know. Putting a towel there was thoughtful and helped keep the water from causing a bigger mess. It was reassuring to come home and see that everything had been looked after with such care.
